inputs.text: [excited] It was 7 meters long — like two cars, one behind the other! [quickly] Standing up, it was 2.4 meters tall — as tall as a soccer goal! And it weighed 350 kilos — [amazed] as heavy as 2 donkeys! [serious] And it could run about 16 miles an hour — as fast as a bike going fast.
[confident] Fast enough, yes. [quickly] Long, thin legs, built for running.
